notes.what: Seal no longer verifies on the published branch because machine paths in the sealed file were replaced (absolute local paths by repo-relative or placeholder paths) when it was published. local_sha256 is the sealed hash; the original is at local_commit in the owner's local history, or (local_file) in the owner's worktree or its git-ignored cache. Each redaction gives the line, the published replacement span and the original span's sha256/length; restoring the original spans reproduces local_sha256 exactly (checked when this note was written). No score, seal or verdict changed.
